next.reason: 1985 a-c: characters transferred by alphanumeric-to-alphanumeric move rules without space filling; DELIMITED without SIZE stops at the end of sender, end of receiver or the delimiter, which is not transferred; with SIZE the whole sender goes; repeated for every sender. §2023:14.9.43.4 GR3 a-c repeat these rules and add only national-to-national moves (national operands are 2023-only, §2023:14.9.43.3 SR1) and zero-length operands ('If an identifier-1 references a zero-length item, that sending operand is ignored'; a zero-length identifier-2 acts as SIZE). Neither reaches a 1985 program that 2023 accepts: zero-length items arise only from dynamic-length items or variable-length groups, and §2023:14.9.43.3 SR11 bars variable-length groups as identifier-1/2/3 (that refusal of a 1985 ODO-group operand belongs to the operand rule, not to this transfer rule), and §2023:14.9.43.3 SR3 bars a zero-length literal-2. Transfer semantics are the same for every 1985 program.
